item.title: Arkansas Storm Team Forecast: Stormy Pattern Ahead
item.description: Then we turn our attention to the middle of next week. There’s a low chance for storms on Wednesday, and a few of those could be gusty. We’re still working through the details, but it does look like we’re heading into a more active pattern mid to late week.

item.title: Little Rock police investigating after person struck, killed by vehicle early Sunday
item.description: LITTLE ROCK, Ark. – Officials with the Little Rock Police Department are investigating after a person died early Sunday morning when they were struck by a vehicle on the Woodrow Street overpass above Interstate 630. item.title: Early voting underway in Arkansas for the March 3 primary & election
item.description: Arkansans can early vote from Feb. 17 through March 2 for the March 3 election, which includes a preferential primary and a special election for House District 70 and Senate District 26.
